answer: Unique-Response Attestation. Each identity must submit a sealed random challenge whose answer is provably bound to its own ledger history; replicas inherit identical answers and are rejected. Verification threads the challenge through a shared prism of committed hashes, so reuse collapses. A pigment of provenance tags each response. Forging a fresh answer costs one full recomputation and storage proof per identity, making mass duplication pay linearly.
